title: Editing src/ silences DD for the rest of the session
trigger: After editing any file under src/ in this checkout during a session, or when DD hooks stop injecting knowledge mid-session
behavior_delta: After a src/ edit, restart the resident by piping a session-start payload into `node hooks/run.cjs session-start` (it replaces the stale resident and waits for the new one); a detached spawn from the Bash tool dies with the tool call. Check with GET /api/resident that stale is false.
what: After a src/ edit, restart the resident by piping a session-start payload into `node hooks/run.cjs session-start` (it replaces the stale resident and waits for the new one); a detached spawn from the Bash tool dies with the tool call. Check with GET /api/resident that stale is false.
why: The resident fingerprints src/ at start and refuses every hook once it changes (build_stale), and only a session start replaces it, so after an edit the rest of the session gets no recall and only one inactive notice. On 2026-09-23 this left long stretches of the session with no injections.
